items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So the first date was Billy Bergs and I had Jimmy Rowles on piano

ctx.x: He was Indian, from Colorado. There was a couple of wonderful musicians, good friend of Jimmy Rowles Rose up in Spokane, that were great musicians. John Benson (?)?

items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Rowles Rhodes was coming with me

ctx.x: And we opened it and Duke followed us, I think -- that was a good -- then it looked like I was going to lose everything in the Draft, I mean, looked like Shorty was going to go in, and then Hank Kahout to go and Jimmy Rowles Rhodes was coming with me --
